design_decisions_within_adr_discretion: verify_causal_order/parse_event_envelope not added to bundles.__all__ (see new_public_surface above) -- ADR text explicitly leaves this open; evidence 0187 recommended exporting verify_causal_order but did not require it, and the smallest-change path that avoids touching test_bundles.py's exact-set __all__ assertion was chosen.

prior_envelope_sha256 chain-check compares against tape.ordered_envelope_digests[parent_index] (the tape's own already-verified digest for that position), not a re-derived hash -- consistent with Decision point 1's closing paragraph that the envelope's own digest 'lives only in the tape's ordered_envelope_digests, never as a field inside the envelope itself', and with the per-position digest check (bullet 2) already having proven that digest equals sha256(ordered_envelope_bytes[parent_index]).

no separate cycle-walk or recursion for the correction_position==0 bottom-out requirement (row 5): enforcing, for every correction_position>0 envelope independently, that its named parent sits at a strictly LOWER tape position with correction_position exactly one less, is sufficient by itself to guarantee termination at 0 with no cycle possible (a cycle would require some link's parent to be at a position >= its own position, which the per-link check already refuses) -- verified against all three row-5 sub-cases (dangling, 2-cycle, longer cycle) in the focused test run. This also trivially satisfies the row-5 forbidden_effect around unbounded recursion, since the implementation contains no recursion or unbounded loop at all.
